name: Brick LOD Selection
aliases: Choix du niveau de LOD des briques
definition: Determines the LOD level of bricks based on distance to the viewpoint, aiming for a voxel projection that exactly covers a screen pixel.
summary: Brick LOD Selection determines the level of detail for volumetric bricks based on viewpoint distance, differing from other methods by calculating resolution bounds for entire brick volumes rather than individual samples.
